title: Update in Place
statement:
Arrays can be **modified in place** — assign a new value directly at an index.

Read **n**, the array, index **i**, and value **x**. Set **a[i] = x**, then print the updated array space-separated.
ioRules:
- Line 1: **n**
- Line 2: **n** integers
- Line 3: **i** and **x** (space-separated)
- Output: updated array, space-separated
